title: Pullback compositor respects strict scalar extension
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, an algebra map $i:E\to F$, and their integer rings $A,B$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the derived categories of strict constant-coefficient module towers, the functors $G_H,J_H,R_H$, and their specified compositors [def-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-arrows], [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations], [def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension]. Let $T_W$ be finite scalar extension, $h_f$ the inverse of strictScalarPull, $b_f$ the openTensor map, and $a_f$ the proper scalar mate [def-pur-constant-scalar-tower-mates], [lem-pur-compact-support-strict-scalar-mate]. For arbitrary scheme maps $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$ and $M\in D(\mathrm{Tow}(A_Z))$, the two routes from $G_{gf,B}T_ZM$ to $T_XG_{f,A}G_{g,A}M$ coincide: $gComp_B;G_{f,B}(h_g);h_fG_{g,A}=h_{gf};T_X(gComp_A)$.

source.place: Tags 07A6, 0D6D, derived-pullback-composition and derived-pushforward-composition; strict scalar refinement Steps 3--4.

proof.text: For the ordinary coefficient restriction/direct-image comparisons, compare successive base changes with the base change along the composite. Both maps send a section to itself on the canonically identified iterated base-change object. The ordinary direct-image compositor makes this an equality of module sheaf maps, and applying it levelwise retains every strict transition.

Derive the preceding equality using the specified whole-complex unitCompatible normalizations of properRestriction. The universal property of derived functors identifies both pasted derived comparisons from their ordinary maps and resolution units. Take conjugates under the composite geometric/scalar adjunctions. The resulting left comparison is the published strictScalarPull, and its geometric compositor is gComp. This gives the displayed equation before evaluation or inverse limit.

lean.statement:
theorem strictScalarPullComposition {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (M : Derived (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) Z) :
    (gComp (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F)) f g).hom.app
        ((T l E F i Z).obj M) ≫
        (G (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F)) f).map
          ((strictScalarPull l E F i g).inv.app M) ≫
        (strictScalarPull l E F i f).inv.app
          ((G (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) g).obj M) =
      (strictScalarPull l E F i (f ≫ g)).inv.app M ≫
        (T l E F i X).map
          ((gComp (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) f g).hom.app M)
lean.note: The section parameters l, E, F, i and their instances occur above the theorem in the module; this field reproduces its written signature verbatim.
